question: Do three newly rendered complete sequences stay inside both the previously validated static PNG8 envelope and the independently derived temporal cross-run residual envelope?

design.type: three fresh Blender processes, each rendering frames 1 through 144 sequentially

frozenTemporalEnvelope.definition: T_t = (A_t - B_t) - (A_(t-1) - B_(t-1)) over decoded RGB

validationGate.provenanceAndStructure: All three renders pass exact identity, source, plan, structure, control, process, frame-count, layout, order and output-hash gates.
validationGate.static: All 432 frame pairs pass all three frozen B24 PNG8 numeric ceilings.
validationGate.temporal: All 429 adjacent-frame residual transitions pass all three frozen B25 temporal numeric ceilings.

decisionRule.TEMPORAL_RESIDUAL_ENVELOPE_SUPPORT: Static passes 432/432, temporal passes 429/429 and every provenance gate passes.
decisionRule.TEMPORAL_ONLY_ENVELOPE_FAIL: Static passes 432/432 while one or more temporal transitions fail, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.STATIC_AND_TEMPORAL_ENVELOPE_FAIL: Both the static and temporal envelopes have one or more failures, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.STATIC_ONLY_ENVELOPE_FAIL: Temporal passes 429/429 while one or more static frame pairs fail, with a valid experiment.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any derivation, B24, identity, source-state, process, control, count, layout, file, metric, binding, envelope or attack gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: source thread state or requested fixed controls mismatch
replicate process binding or PID uniqueness mismatch
frame order or render count mismatch
comparison loses manifest or file hash binding
explicitNonClaims: Passing validates one numerical temporal residual envelope for one held-out scene/profile/machine/build; it does not establish a universal Blender tolerance.
The metric isolates frame-to-frame change in cross-run disagreement but is not proof that a viewer cannot see flicker or other temporal artifacts.
This is not a bitwise determinism claim; PNG container hashes and some decoded pixels may differ.
The review proxy is PNG8 at 960x540 without motion blur, not a scene-linear master or final cinema delivery.
Human subjective review remains pending and must record anonymization, player, display and viewing conditions.
Nothing generalizes to Cycles, another GPU/backend, another machine, another scene, longer shots or different temporal effects.
